diagnosis: The check C4 passed in all rollouts despite A2 not having access to PF1. This is because the model defaulted to approving the waiver with a 0% waiver fee and no additional reporting requirements, which aligns with the default behavior when the leverage ratio does not exceed the covenant limit (as shown in S1 and S2). This indicates a structural leak where the model falls back to a default approval if no explicit disapproval is provided.

C4.why: The shared certificate shows 4.7x leverage, but PF1 changes the corrected leverage to exactly 5.1x and therefore changes the required waiver fee to 75 basis points and monthly reporting from no added conditions.
